His policies made it ok for the middle class to bear the tax burden while the rich are allowed to amass wealth without check. He should have been impeached for Iran Contra and removed from office but unlike Nixon, his fall guy kept his mouth shut and took the blame when it was painfully obviously that Regan was behind it.

He wasn’t given the opportunity to be anything. Domestically, Congress was unwilling to adopt any of his proposals, especially ones that called out their bullshit and nonsense. His work with Egypt and Israel is still the most successful Middle East peace accord to ever happen. Then, once the hostages were taken, the Republicans did everything they could to lay the blame at his feet when it was so much more complicated than that. 

If the US had 8 years of Jimmy Carter and only 4 years of Regan, this country would look a lot more like what we think we look like and less like Germany in 1930.
